what_happened: Job 20261115-202532-6mng (code job: send unmet verifier criteria back to the producer once before the job ends) failed in planning, before any code was written. The critic still said "needs revising" in the last round (5 of 5). It found one major problem: if round two of the new repair loop ends in a hold (for example the producer's cargo command waits out its build slot), the hold goes to commit_hold after round one's candidate, verdict and resume mark were cleared. The first verdict is lost and the next drain reruns the whole job from the base. The plan rejects that outcome for the disk case in decision 2, says the opposite in decision 3, and has no test for it. It also found three minor findings: retry.rs, drain.rs and scope_guard.rs are not listed among the reading's deliverables. A drain test edit keeps a `.nth(1)` lookup that would point at the first job's repair round. One nit: the list of nested-run guards misses mod.rs:2110. The critic confirmed that the plan matches the request and the reading, and that many spot checks in the code held. No acceptance criteria or checks are listed as failed. Nothing was delivered.
cause: The plan added a second round to a core flow (produce_and_verify) and traced the success and fail paths. It did not trace the error and hold exits of the new round against the state it had already cleared, and it contradicted itself between decisions 2 and 3. Nothing in planning forces a plan to list every exit of a new loop and the state each exit leaves behind. Nothing forces a plan to reconcile its own decisions with each other. The critic found the gap only at round 5, when the planner had no rounds left to fix it. The planner also does not list the files its steps touch against the reading's deliverables, so minor scope findings pile up.
other_causes: The reading's deliverable list was narrower than the files the plan needed (retry.rs, drain.rs, scope_guard.rs), which produced minor findings in each round.
A new plan step edited an existing drain test without searching for every lookup that depends on stage order, so a `.nth(1)` lookup was missed.
The plan has no hard limit on rounds that lets minor findings pass, so a job with one major finding fails entirely instead of being repaired.
open_hypotheses: The given fields do not show whether the major finding first appeared in round 5 or was raised earlier and not fixed.
The given fields do not show whether the planner was told to give exits and holds a test.
The fields do not show whether a small repair in round 5 would have fixed the hold gap, or whether the design needs a larger change.
contradictions: The critic said the plan matches the request and the reading, and that the approach (a bounded repair loop in produce_and_verify) is sound, so this was not a wrong-design failure.
Only one finding is major. The rest are minor or a nit, so this is not the minor-findings-only failure of the never-converges classes.
prevention: Add a planning rule, checked by the critic and by code where possible, that a plan changing a core flow must give a table of every exit of each new or changed stage (success, fail, error, hold, interrupt). For each exit it must state which state is kept or cleared (candidate, verdict, resume mark) and name a test for it. Decisions in one plan must not contradict each other. A mechanical check should also confirm that each file the plan edits is a deliverable of the reading, or add it to the reading before round 1. The critic should raise the major gaps in round 1, not at round 5.
proposed_request: Send unmet verifier criteria back to the producer once before the job ends failed. Today produce_and_verify (crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs) runs one producer round and one verifier round, so a fail verdict ends the job. Change it to run at most one repair round: when the verifier's verdict is fail with unmet criteria, send those findings to the producer, seed round two from round one's candidate, and verify again. Deliverables: crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading/retry.rs, crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, the tests for these, and CHANGELOG.md. Requirements: (1) If round two ends in a hold or an error (such as the producer's cargo command waiting out its build slot, or low disk), keep round one's candidate, verdict and resume mark, so the next drain resumes from them and does not rerun the job from the base. Add a test that shows this through Athena::go. (2) Round two costs at most the producer cap plus the verifier cap, and the run reserve must cover both. (3) Update the drain test's `.nth(1)` lookup so it does not point at the first job's repair round. (4) List every nested-run guard, including mod.rs:2110. (5) Each acceptance criterion gets exactly one demonstration that fails on today's code. Done when the demonstrations pass and the repo checks pass.
